meta.title: KAFRIADA NET — your permanent football ID
meta.description: Register free and receive a permanent KAFRIADA NET ID with a QR profile any club or scout can check. Jigawa State pilot.

styleguide.title: Style guide
styleguide.lede: Every token and building block of KAFRIADA NET, in one place. Review it in light and dark before screens are built.
styleguide.sampleBody: Register once and receive an ID that is yours for life. Any club or scout can check it in seconds.

ui.tellCoordinator: Tell your LGA coordinator this code

card.scanHelp: Any phone camera opens this player's public profile. It never shows a phone number or date of birth.
card.issuedBy: Issued by KAFRIADA NET · Federation of Nigerian Sports

home.title: Your permanent football ID. Free.
home.lede: Register once and receive a KAFRIADA NET ID that is yours for life. Any club or scout can check it in seconds.
home.free: Free to register. About five minutes.

how.title: Register
how.text: Your details, your position, your LGA.

how.title: Get your ID
how.text: A number like KA-NG-JG-BKD-2026-000123 that never changes.

how.title: Get scanned
how.text: Anyone can scan your card and see your profile. No account needed.

home.openNone: Registration opens LGA by LGA. Check back soon.
home.verifyText: Add your photograph and a verified badge for ₦2,500, checked by your LGA coordinator. Pay by card, or in cash to your coordinator. Your ID works either way.
home.clubsText: Register your club, add your players by their ID, and get a verified club badge.

find.title: Look up an athlete
find.lede: Enter the ID printed on the card. No account needed.
find.label: KAFRIADA NET ID
find.hint: For example KA-NG-JG-BKD-2026-000123: capital letters, numbers and dashes.
find.empty: Enter the ID printed on the card.
find.scan: Easier still: point your phone camera at the QR code on the card.

register.title: Get your free ID
register.lede: About five minutes. Have your phone, your email and an emergency contact's number ready. Every field is needed unless it says optional.
register.summary: We could not register you yet
register.unreachable: We could not reach KAFRIADA NET
register.unreachableText: The list of areas did not load. Nothing was saved. Try again in a moment.
register.firstNameHint: As written on your ID document.
register.emailHint: We send a code here to confirm it.
register.lgaHint: Where you live and register. It is printed into your ID and never changes.
register.lgaClosed: Opening soon, not yet accepting registrations
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short phrase you will remember works well.
register.consent: I am 18 or older, the details above are true, and I accept the <privacy>privacy notice</privacy>. If I later ask to be deleted, my personal details are erased but my KAFRIADA NET ID and payment records are kept.

confirm.title: Enter the code we emailed
confirm.sentTo: Sent to {email}. Check your spam folder if it has not arrived within a few minutes.
confirm.safeText: The code only opens your account. Nothing is lost if it takes a while.
confirm.sent: Another code is on its way
confirm.label: 6-digit code
confirm.hint: It expires in 10 minutes. KAFRIADA NET will never ask you for it.
confirm.why: Your account opens once your email is confirmed. We use it for receipts, verification decisions and to help you back in if you forget your password.

done.title: {name}, this is your ID
done.permanent: This ID is permanent. It never changes.
done.nextText: Add your photograph and a verified badge for ₦2,500. Pay by card, or in cash to your LGA coordinator.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.error: We could not sign you in
signIn.resetText: Sign in with your new password. Every other device was signed out.
signIn.endedText: You were signed out to keep your account safe. Sign in again to continue.
signIn.emailHint: Your account has no email yet. We will send a code to confirm it.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lede: We send a code to confirm it is you.
forgot.sentText: If that phone number or email belongs to a KAFRIADA NET account, a code is on its way. It expires in 10 minutes.
forgot.newPasswordHint: At least 10 characters. A short phrase you will remember works well.
forgot.signedOut: Every device signed in to this account will be signed out.

profile.issuedText: This QR code came from KAFRIADA NET. Check that the photograph matches the person in front of you.
profile.unsignedText: This page was opened without a KAFRIADA NET QR code, so we cannot confirm where the link came from. The record below is still correct.
profile.privacy: This page shows only what an athlete has agreed to publish. It never shows a phone number, a date of birth or any identity document.
profile.notFoundText: Check the ID printed on the card and try again. An ID looks like KA-NG-JG-BKD-2026-000123.

errors.serverTitle: Something went wrong at our end
errors.serverText: Nothing you did caused this, and nothing you entered was lost. Try again in a moment.
errors.refHelp: Quote this code if you call for help.
errors.notFoundText: The address may be mistyped, or the page has moved.
errors.unreachableTitle: We could not reach KAFRIADA NET
errors.unreachableText: Nothing you entered was lost. The connection may be slow; try again in a moment.
errors.offlineText: Your phone has no connection right now. Your ID is safe. Try again when you have signal.

cardPage.title: Your KAFRIADA NET card
cardPage.heading: {name}, this is your card
cardPage.lede: Print it, download it, or write the number down. All three work.
cardPage.printText: Use your browser's Print command on this page. Only the card goes on the paper. Cut along the edge.
cardPage.keepText: It records where you first registered. It stays the same if you move or change clubs.
cardPage.verifyText: For ₦2,500 your LGA coordinator checks your ID document. Your profile then shows the verified badge and your photograph. No bank card? Pay your LGA coordinator in cash.

me.title: My account
me.cardText: Print or download your ID card.
me.profileText: What a club or scout sees when they scan.
me.clubsText: Invitations and the club you play for.

status.noneText: Add your photograph and a verified badge for {price}.
status.draftText: Finish adding your files, then pay.
status.under_reviewText: Your LGA coordinator is checking your documents.
status.approvedText: Your photograph and badge are on your public profile.
status.rejectedText: See the reason and send new files. You do not pay again.
status.escalatedText: Your LGA coordinator will help you in person.

me.adminText: Money, users, clubs and the audit log.
me.clubNewText: For a club that cannot sign itself up.
me.staffTimeout: Staff are signed out after 30 minutes without activity, because phones are shared in the field.

details.title: My details
details.lede: Keep these up to date. Coordinators and clubs rely on them.
details.incompleteText: You registered before these details were asked for. Fill in every field below and save.
details.noAthleteText: This account is not registered as an athlete.
details.error: We could not save your details
details.fixedText: Your ID records where you first registered, not where you live now. To change anything here, speak to your LGA coordinator.
details.name: Name

payments.title: My payments
payments.caption: Payments
payments.notABank: KAFRIADA NET records the payments you make. It is not a bank account: money cannot be withdrawn or sent to another person.

clubsMine.title: My clubs
clubsMine.acceptedText: Your club now shows on your record.
clubsMine.declinedText: It has been removed from your list.
clubsMine.noClub: You are not in a club
clubsMine.noClubText: A club adds you by inviting your KAFRIADA NET ID. Share your ID with the club's official.
clubsMine.noInvitationsText: When a club invites you, it appears here.
clubsMine.wants: wants to add you to their squad

verify.title: Get verified
verify.savedText: Your file is saved. Add the other one if you have not yet.
verify.notAthleteText: This account has no athlete record.
verify.pitch: Add your photo and a verified badge
gets: Your photo on your public profile
A verified badge scouts can trust
verify.needDocument: A photo of your ID document
verify.routesTitle: Two ways to pay, the same result
verify.cardText: Add your two photos here, then pay with Paystack.
verify.cashText: Take {price} to your LGA coordinator in {lga}. They take your photos and pay for you, and you get a receipt by message.
verify.photoHint: Face clearly visible, no cap, no sunglasses.
verify.documentHint: NIN slip, voter's card, driver's licence or passport.

file.unreadable: We could not read that file. Send another.

verify.uploadNote: Maximum 10 MB per image. Your document is used only to check your identity and age, and is deleted 30 days after a decision. Your photo stays on your profile.
verify.processing: We are getting your files ready.
verify.needBoth: Add both files to continue to payment.
verify.reviewLead: Your LGA coordinator is checking your documents.
verify.reviewNotify: We will send a message to {phone} when a decision is made. You do not need to keep this page open.
verify.approvedLead: Your photo and badge are live.
verify.approvedText: Anyone who scans your card now sees your photograph.
verify.attemptsLeft: {count, plural, one {You have # more attempt.} other {You have # more attempts.}}
verify.resubmitNeed: Both files must be added and ready before you send it again.
verify.escalatedLead: We could not approve this after three tries.
verify.escalatedText: Your LGA coordinator will help you in person. You do not need to pay again.

pay.title: Payment
pay.error: We could not start your payment
pay.alreadyPaid: You have already paid for this. Nothing more is due.
pay.leave: You will leave KAFRIADA NET to pay. We never see your card details.
pay.cash: No card? Pay your LGA coordinator in cash instead.
pay.notFound: We could not find that payment
pay.notFoundText: It may belong to another account.
pay.checkingSoon: This usually takes a few seconds.
pay.checkingLong: This is taking longer than usual. There is no need to keep refreshing.
pay.checkingSafe: You can close this page safely. When the payment is confirmed it shows here.
pay.review: Your payment needs a check by our team
pay.reviewText: Do not pay again. We will contact you on the phone number you registered with.
pay.failedText: If money left your account, it shows here as confirmed once Paystack tells us. Otherwise you can try again.

clubFields.name: Registered name
clubFields.nameHint: As the club is known officially.
clubFields.ageGroupsHint: Tick every age group the club fields a team in.
clubFields.secondHint: Someone else at the club we can reach.

clubSignup.title: Register your club
clubSignup.lede: Free. For a club's chairman, secretary, manager or coach. About ten minutes.
steps: Fill in the club's details and your own.
Confirm your email with the code we send.
An administrator reviews the club. Once approved, you add players.
clubSignup.price: Registering a club is free. A verified club badge is optional and comes later, once the club is approved.
clubSignup.error: We could not register the club yet
clubSignup.duplicateText: If yours is a different club, tick the box below and submit again.
clubSignup.duplicateBox: This is a different club with the same name
clubSignup.unreachable: We could not reach KAFRIADA NET
clubSignup.unreachableText: The list of areas did not load. Nothing was saved. Try again in a moment.
clubSignup.youHint: This becomes the club's account. Use your own phone and email, not the club's.
clubSignup.emailHint: We send a code here to confirm it.
clubSignup.consent: I represent this club, the details above are true, and I accept the <privacy>privacy notice</privacy>.

clubNew.title: Register a club for someone
clubNew.ledeAdmin: You become the club's administrator. Clubs normally sign themselves up.
clubNew.ledeCoordinator: For a club in {lga} that cannot sign itself up. You become its administrator.
clubNew.error: We could not register the club

clubEdit.title: Edit club details
clubEdit.lede: Every field is needed unless it says optional. Sport and area stay as registered.
clubEdit.noAccess: You can only edit a club you administer.

club.noAccessTitle: This club is not yours to open
club.noAccess: You can only open a club you administer.
club.registeredText: You are now this club's administrator.
club.invitedText: The player appears in your squad once they accept.
club.pendingText: An administrator reviews every new club. Once it is approved you can build a squad.
club.notVerifiedText: Verify your club for {price} to show a club badge and receive transfers.
club.noPlayersText: A player joins by accepting an invitation from this club.
club.noInvitesText: Invitations you send appear here until the player answers.
club.incompleteText: Fill in the missing details so reviewers have the full picture.

invite.title: Add a player
invite.noAccess: You can only add players to a club you administer.
invite.label: KAFRIADA NET ID or phone number
invite.hint: Enter the full ID or number. Players cannot be browsed.
invite.notFoundText: Check the ID or number and try again.
invite.onRoster: This player is already in your squad.
invite.alreadyInvited: You have already invited this player.
invite.atClub: This player is at {club}. Accepting your invitation moves them to your club.
invite.mustAccept: The player must accept before they appear in your squad.
invite.privacy: Exact match only. A club can find a player it already knows, never browse the register.

clubVerify.title: Verify your club
clubVerify.noAccess: You can only verify a club you administer.
clubVerify.verifiedText: The verified badge shows on your club page.
clubVerify.waitingText: A club must be approved before it can be verified.
clubVerify.reviewText: An administrator is checking your document. You will be told when it is decided.
gets: A verified badge on your club page
Checked by a KAFRIADA NET administrator
clubVerify.documentHint: A clear photo or scan of the whole page.

file.unreadable: We could not read that file. Send another.

clubVerify.uploadNote: Maximum 10 MB. The document is used only to check the club.
clubVerify.covered: The payment you already made covers this.
clubVerify.paid: This club has already paid. Nothing more is due.
clubVerify.leave: You will leave KAFRIADA NET to pay. We never see your card details.
clubVerify.confirmedText: We received {amount}. Your club is now with an administrator.
clubVerify.checkingText: This usually takes a few seconds. You can close this page safely.
clubVerify.needsCheck: Your payment needs a check by our team
clubVerify.needsCheckText: Do not pay again. We will contact you on the phone number you registered with.
clubVerify.failedText: If money left your account, it shows here as confirmed once Paystack tells us. Otherwise you can try again below.

coord.title: Today
coord.noLgaText: This account does not coordinate a local government area.
coord.noAccessText: You can only open your own local government area.
coord.clearText: Every verification in this LGA has been decided.
coord.waitingText: {count, plural, one {One verification needs} other {# verifications need}} a decision. The target is 24 hours.
coord.todo: What do you need to do?
coord.findText: Search this LGA by name, phone or ID.
coord.cardsText: Eight cards to an A4 sheet.
coord.payText: Record a cash payment for verification.
coord.capped: You have reached today's limit. Assisted payments start again tomorrow.

review.title: Case {n} of {total}
review.noLgaText: Reviews are done by the coordinator of the athlete's LGA.
review.noAccessText: You can only review athletes in your own LGA.
review.escalated: Rejected, and sent to the coordinator
review.told: The athlete has been told by message.
review.allCaughtText: No verifications are waiting in this LGA.
review.endText: You have looked at every case.
review.documentAlt: The identity document the athlete submitted
review.name: Name
checklist: The face matches the photo on the document
review.rejectHint: The athlete reads this exactly as you write it. Say what to fix.

find2.title: Find an athlete
find2.noLgaText: Choose a local government area on your dashboard first.
find2.label: KAFRIADA NET ID, phone or name
find2.noAccessText: You can only search your own local government area.
find2.noneText: Nobody in this LGA matches. Check the spelling or try the phone number.
find2.caption: Athletes found

assist.title: Pay for an athlete
assist.lede: For someone who cannot pay online. Your card is charged; the badge and the receipt are theirs.
assist.noLgaText: Assisted payment is done by the coordinator of the athlete's own LGA.
assist.kuidHint: An athlete in your own LGA who has already added a photo and ID document.
assist.receipt: The athlete gets a receipt by message as soon as the payment is confirmed. Collect the cash first.
assist.collected: I have collected the verification fee in cash from this athlete.
assist.failedNote: If the payment does not go through, nothing is recorded: give the cash back.

cards2.title: Print cards
cards2.lede: Find the athletes whose cards you need, then print or download them.
cards2.noLgaText: Choose a local government area on your dashboard first.
cards2.forbidden: You can only print cards for your own local government area.
cards2.marked: {count, plural, one {One card is} other {# cards are}} now marked as printed.
cards2.noneText: Change the dates or show all cards.
cards2.summary: {total, plural, one {# athlete} other {# athletes}} · {sheets, plural, one {# sheet} other {# sheets}} of A4, {per} cards per sheet
cards2.pageOf: This is page {page} of {pages}: {cards} cards, {sheets} sheets.
cards2.howTo: Use your browser's Print command. The cards print eight to a sheet at card size. If it cannot print from here, download the PDF.

settle.title: Cash settlement
settle.lede: Every payment you collected cash for, against what Paystack has confirmed. Hand in the confirmed total; chase anything still outstanding.
settle.balancedText: Everything collected in this period has been confirmed by Paystack.
settle.shortText: {pending, plural, =0 {} one {# payment is waiting for Paystack. } other {# payments are waiting for Paystack. }}{review, plural, =0 {} one {# needs a check. } other {# need a check. }}{abandoned, plural, =0 {} one {# was never paid in: the cash is still held.} other {# were never paid in: the cash is still held.}}
settle.caption: Payments collected between {since} and {until}
settle.truncated: Showing the latest 2,000 payments. Narrow the dates, or download the CSV for the same lines.
settle.none: No cash collected in this period
settle.noneText: Payments you take on an athlete’s behalf appear here.
settle.noLgaText: The settlement report covers one LGA. Ask an administrator to assign yours.
settle.forbidden: You do not coordinate this LGA.
settle.badDates: Choose an end date on or after the start date, no more than a year apart.
